reference: The knot was checked twice before she leaned back into the rope.
sk: Uzol bol skontrolovaný dvakrát, kým sa oprela do lana.
cz: Uzel byl zkontrolován dvakrát, než se opřela do lana.
acceptable: The knot was {checked|inspected} twice before she {leaned|leant} {back |}into the rope.
Before she {leaned|leant} {back |}into the rope, the knot was {checked|inspected} twice.

mistakes.text: The knot checked twice before she leaned back into the rope.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Uzol sám nič nekontroluje, preto treba Passive s „was“: „was checked“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Uzel sám nic nekontroluje, proto je potřeba Passive s „was“: „was checked“.
mistakes.feedback_en: The knot doesn't check anything, so use Passive with “was”: “was checked”.

mistakes.text: The knot was check twice before she leaned back into the rope.
mistakes.feedback_sk: V Passive patrí za „was“ past participle: „checked“, nie „check“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: V Passive patří za „was“ past participle: „checked“, ne „check“.
mistakes.feedback_en: Passive needs the past participle after “was”: “checked”, not “check”.

mistakes.text: The knot is checked twice before she leaned back into the rope.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Dej sa odohral v minulosti, preto „was checked“, nie „is checked“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Děj proběhl v minulosti, proto „was checked“, ne „is checked“.
mistakes.feedback_en: The action happened in the past, so use “was checked”, not “is checked”.

mistakes.text: {Someone|They} checked the knot twice before she leaned back into the rope.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Cvičenie precvičuje Passive: podmetom je uzol, teda „the knot was checked“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Cvičení procvičuje Passive: podmětem je uzel, tedy „the knot was checked“.
mistakes.feedback_en: This exercise practises the Passive: the knot is the subject, “the knot was checked”.

mistakes.text: The knot was checked two times before she leaned back into the rope.
The knot was checked twice before she leaned herself back into the rope.
mistakes.feedback_sk: „Oprela sa“ je len „leaned“; „herself“ sa sem nepridáva.
mistakes.feedback_cz: „Opřela se“ je jen „leaned“; „herself“ se sem nepřidává.
mistakes.feedback_en: “Lean” needs no reflexive pronoun: “she leaned”, not “leaned herself”.

source_issues: English “leaned back into” has “back”, which Slovak “oprela sa do” and Czech “opřela se do” do not; both versions are accepted.
